key_idea: Build a self-dual 'gadget' matroid Q whose bases push an ultrafilter-based ordinal rank strictly down from one side to the other, then chain copies of Q along a double ray so that any independent covering would produce an infinite descending sequence of ordinals.
reason: The end of the proof, an ordinal descent along a double ray, is short and striking, and it explains clearly why no covering can exist. Most of the work goes into building Q, which takes a long technical machinery of two density ideals, independent binary columns, probe estimates, interpolation lemmas and a transfinite recursion of length continuum, and this hides the core idea under heavy bookkeeping.
